subject.title: Feature: Auto-leave WhatsApp groups not in allowlist + group-join webhook

question: Should OpenClaw add a WhatsApp-specific opt-in auto-leave/group-join feature now, fold this into the broader cross-channel group-pairing design, or keep the current drop-only behavior?
rationale: The request adds new config and security-sensitive channel behavior that can remove the bot from groups and expose group metadata, so automation should not choose the permanent product and authorization shape alone.

options.title: Implement opt-in WhatsApp guard
options.body: Add a WhatsApp plugin-owned auto-leave and owner-notification path guarded by explicit config, authorization checks, docs, tests, and live proof.

options.title: Fold into group pairing
options.body: Use the broader group-pairing design to define the event, approval, reject, and optional leave semantics across channels before changing WhatsApp behavior.

options.title: Keep drop-only behavior
options.body: Leave current group allowlist enforcement as-is and document manual WhatsApp cleanup as the supported security posture for now.

recommendation.title: Implement opt-in WhatsApp guard
recommendation.body: Add a WhatsApp plugin-owned auto-leave and owner-notification path guarded by explicit config, authorization checks, docs, tests, and live proof.
